name: @hdsp/connector-installer
description: Packaging project for ZoeConnect Connector 1.0 Deployment (2026-07-22, Phase 1: Packaging). Produces HDSP_Connector_1.0.0_x64.exe from connector/, connector-manager/, and connector-tray/'s build outputs plus this folder's install/uninstall-service helper scripts. See README.md for the full pipeline and why nothing here has been built/verified in this sandbox (no Windows environment).

scripts.package:scripts: pkg scripts/install-service.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output build/install-service.exe && pkg scripts/uninstall-service.js --targets node18-win-x64 --output build/uninstall-service.exe
scripts.build:installer: echo Run this on Windows with Inno Setup installed: iscc HDSP_Connector.iss
